title: The Signal Fire
text: Smoke rises from a far hill in broken puffs, in the pattern your House uses. Someone is still alive out there. The smoke stops, then starts again, weaker. It is a long way, and the land between is broken.

options.label: Run for the far hill before the smoke stops for good.

outcomes.text: You draw closer over broken ground, your legs battered by it.

options.label: Light an answering fire so they know someone is coming.
The sharpest scouts the way so you do not break your legs getting there.

outcomes.text: They find a safe path to the hill, if you are quick.
